architecture.catalyst_transaction: explicit slot transform that changes damage without changing count
architecture.recipe_index: CONSUME inputs are primary candidate keys; WEAR/PRESERVE keys are fallback-only when a recipe has no consumed item or fluid; explicitly whitelisted string components use item id plus component id and value
architecture.vanilla_damageability_marker: item prototype MAX_DAMAGE=1 and DAMAGE=0; marker is not material data and is omitted from stack patches

exact_wood_exclusion.reason: GT6 MT.Wood implements ICondition by object identity; MT.Wood.NOT excludes only exact MT.Wood and must not be widened to the PROPERTIES.WOOD tag

stone_pickaxe_route.reason: The existing CrucibleCraft direct rod bootstrap is intentionally retained only for the exact stone material; it is not inferred from a STONE tag
